response.original_title: (Official-Guide) How do I add another stateroom on Norwegian Cruise Line?
response.overview: You  +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK),can add another room to an existing Norwegian Cruise Line booking by calling customer service directly at +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK), or by contacting your travel agent. To add another stateroom to an existing Norwegian Cruise Line booking, contact 【+1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK)】Norwegian Cruise Line or your travel advisor and request an additional cabin. Availability, pricing, and booking conditions apply. If you want cabins together, 【+1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK)】ask Norwegian to check adjacent or connecting options. Norwegian confirms that some ships offer two or three connecting staterooms.
